tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across all parsed SEC/FDA/register/weather section bodies (BM25 ranking). Also resolves company names for ticker lookup.

tools.name: dossier
tools.description: Cross-topic dossier for one entity — SEC filings, 13F holdings, mutual fund holdings, FDA recalls as firm, federal register agency mentions, federal contracts as recipient.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Comprehensive dossier for one SEC-filing company: basic info, recent filings, insider activity windows (7/30/90d), upcoming Form 144 sales, latest financials (FY+quarterly), top 13F institutional holders, top mutual-fund holders, peers.

tools.name: company_risk_flags
tools.description: Multi-source red-flag detector for one company — restatements (8-K item 4.02), auditor changes, officer departures, insider cluster sells, upcoming Form 144 pressure, Schedule 13D filings, FDA recalls.

tools.name: company_insider_pulse
tools.description: Unified Form 4 (executed) + Form 144 (proposed-sale) insider timeline for one company.

tools.name: cluster_buys
tools.description: Companies where multiple distinct insiders bought open-market stock in the window. Strong conviction signal.

tools.name: cluster_sells
tools.description: Companies where multiple distinct insiders sold open-market stock in the window. Mass-exit detector.

tools.name: upcoming_sales_pressure
tools.description: Lists companies by the size of insider sales planned in recent SEC Form 144 notices (filed intentions to sell, not completed trades).

tools.name: news
tools.description: Time-ordered cross-topic news feed: insider trades, Form 144 notices, cluster buys/sells, Schedule 13D filings, 8-Ks, FDA recalls, weather alerts, presidential documents.

tools.name: estimate_filing_dates
tools.description: Estimates each company's next 10-Q/10-K filing date from its past SEC filing cadence. Dates are estimates, not announced filing dates.

tools.name: fund_holdings
tools.description: What a mutual fund holds (NPORT-P). Pass a 10-digit CIK or series_id (S000012345).

tools.name: fda_firm_dossier
tools.description: All FDA activity for one firm — recalls + 510(k) clearances + FAERS adverse-event reports.

tools.name: drug_label
tools.description: Look up an FDA drug label by brand, generic, or substance name. Returns indications, dosage, warnings, adverse reactions, drug interactions.

tools.name: watchlist
tools.description: Consolidated activity rollup for a list of tickers — insider 30d net flow, Form 144 pressure, recent material events, cluster-sell flag. Up to 25 tickers per call.

tools.name: cross_vertical_active
tools.description: Discovery feed: list of entities with activity in 2+ regulatory verticals (SEC + FDA + contracts) inside the lookback window. Use to find entities worth pulling a full cross-vertical timeline for.

tools.name: entity_timeline
tools.description: Cross-vertical event timeline for one real-world entity — joins SEC filings/insider/Form144/13D + FDA recalls + FDA drug labels + federal contracts into one ordered feed. Use this when an LLM needs the FULL picture of a company across regulatory verticals. Add min_importance to filter to high-signal

tools.name: entity_material_events
tools.description: Cross-vertical 'alert me' feed for one entity. Returns only high-signal events (importance ≥ 60): Class I FDA recalls, Schedule 13D filings, large insider sales, restatements, large federal contracts, terminated clinical trials, EPA significant-violator status.

tools.name: clinical_trials_recent
tools.description: Recent clinical trial activity from ClinicalTrials.gov. Filter by phase, status, and sponsor. Use for drug pipeline questions.

tools.name: lobbying_by_client
tools.description: Aggregate Senate Lobbying Disclosure dossier for one company: total spend, firms used, top issue codes, recent filings.

tools.name: epa_facilities
tools.description: EPA-regulated facilities owned by a company. Returns location, NAICS, and compliance status. Set violations=1 to only see facilities with EPA violations.

tools.name: patents_recent
tools.description: Recent USPTO patent grants from PatentsView. Filter by assignee company or CPC class. Use for R&D intel and IP portfolio questions.

tools.name: patents_by_assignee
tools.description: Aggregate USPTO patent dossier for one company: total grants, top CPC classes, recent grants, inventor counts.

tools.name: courts_recent
tools.description: Recent federal court dockets from CourtListener. Filter by party, court, or Nature of Suit (850 securities, 830 patent, 410 antitrust, 365/367 product liability, 480 consumer credit).

tools.name: courts_by_party

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "data_broker_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Checks whether a business is registered as a data broker in California, using the MORVS California Data Broker Register: the 2026, 2025 and 2024 registries filed with the California Privacy Protection Agency and the Attorney General's 2020-2023 list, keyed by website domain so a name change at the s" → after: "Checks whether a business is registered as a data broker in California, using the MORVS California Data Broker Register: the yearly registries filed with the California Privacy Protection Agency (2024 onward) and the Attorney General's 2020-2023 list, keyed by website domain so a name change at the "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "data_broker_diff" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Compares two files of the MORVS California Data Broker Register (the 2026, 2025 or 2024 CPPA registry, or the Attorney General's 2020-2023 list) under the register's published method: a registration in the earlier file whose normalised legal name has no registration in the later file is an apparent " → after: "Compares two files of the MORVS California Data Broker Register (a yearly CPPA registry, named by its year, or the Attorney General's 2020-2023 list) under the register's published method: a registration in the earlier file whose normalised legal name has no registration in the later file is an appa"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
